summary_zh: 之后又按正常面试题的写法重写了题干（中英文页都用英文题干），数字和条件不变。

issues.problem_zh: 原题干是一大段长句，把条件、规模、范围和要讨论的话题全挤在一起，读起来不像面试官会说的话；中文版又是逐句硬翻。
issues.change_zh: 按正常面试题的写法重写题干：先一句话说要设计什么，再分块列出已有条件、需求和规模、要交付什么、面试官会追问的话题和不考的范围。所有数字和条件不变，参考解答没有改。按用户要求，中文页的题干也直接用英文。

checked: read README.zh.md and README.md in full and compared them paragraph by paragraph (same numbers in every paragraph, both code blocks identical, mermaid edges identical)
ran page (2 blocks, about 6 s, both languages pass)

recomputed every estimate in my own script (tools/out/scratch/b21/t5_webhook.py): 2,500 events/s, 648M deliveries/day, 7,500 and 22,500 deliveries/s, per-tier lambda 20,250 / 1,800 / 450 per s and L = 4,050 / 5,400 / 4,500 (29% / 39% / 32%), 13,950 in flight, slow + dead = 71%, 70 -> 81 workers, 16,200 slots, 2,250 spare, 29.16M extra attempts/day = 337.5/s = 4.5%, 1,012.5 peak retries/s = 10,125 slots at the timeout, 6.05 TiB of events and 2.65 TiB of delivery rows, backoff 30/90/270/810/1,800/1,800 s = 80 min and 81.2 min with seven timeouts, 0.025 and 0.075 deliveries/s per endpoint, 300 endpoints x 5 slots = 9.3% of the pool, K/W = 25/s (333x the peak average), breaker trip after about 32 s, lease = 3x the request timeout
simulated Little's law for the dead tier (Poisson 450/s holding 10 s -> 4,497 in flight, page says 4,500)

ran the page's interleaving model checker on 9 further configurations (up to 3 endpoints, 3 workers, 3 attempts; up to 1.6M states) and with 0, 1 and 3 worker deaths: no invariant violated and every state can still finish; ran each of the four broken variants on both configurations and confirmed each is caught for the reason the prose gives

checked factual claims: Retry-After applies to 429 and 503; 169.254.169.254 is in the link-local range; IPv4-mapped IPv6 and DNS rebinding handling (resolve, check, connect to the checked address, hostname only for SNI / certificate / Host); HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp.body with a constant-time compare and a 5-minute tolerance; fencing by lease_token on the outcome write; slot entries that expire with the lease
checked the mermaid diagram against the event walk-through
